data.long_description:
Discover modern waterfront living at Cotier House 1 by Imtiaz. This bright and spacious 3-bedroom apartment spans 1,886.48 sqft, offering a perfect blend of comfort and luxury. Enjoy thoughtfully designed interiors, high-quality finishes, and breathtaking views of the marina and surrounding waterfront.


  Located in the prestigious Dubai Islands, residents have easy access to beaches, marinas, and vibrant community amenities, making it ideal for families and professionals alike.


  Key Features:


  - 3 Bedrooms
  - 1,886.48 sqft
  - Living space
  - Prime waterfront location
  - Modern interiors with premium finishes
  - Access to community amenities and leisure facilities





  Embrace the lifestyle you deserve at Cotier House 1 by Imtiaz where luxury meets convenience.
